description: How a folder becomes a workspace, shared by the Mac and iOS clients (WorkspaceFolderPolicy, WorkspaceNaming, WorkspaceTabStripPolicy) and the desktop client (soyeht_client::state, `workspaces`). A typed or chosen path is trimmed, must be absolute and loses its trailing separators; a workspace is named for the last component of its folder; a folder that already has a workspace opens that one; the recent folders are the roots of the workspaces, then the folders panes run in that are not roots; a rename needs a different name that is not blank; and closing the selected workspace selects the next one, or the previous one when the closed one was last. Both clients pass every case.

names.name: the last component names the workspace
a dot folder keeps its dot
a backslash path is split too
the root is named for itself

resolve.name: space and a trailing separator go
a Windows path loses its trailing separator

reuse.name: the workspace with the same path is reused
a parent folder is another workspace

recent.name: workspace roots first, then the folders of panes once each

submission.name: a different name is kept, trimmed
the same name is not sent again
a blank name is not sent

closing.name: closing the first selects the next
closing a middle one selects the next
closing the last selects the previous
closing the only one selects nothing
closing one that is not listed selects nothing
